team.name: Mohammad Haseeb
team.bio: Mohammad Haseeb brings sales and day-to-day operations together, keeping the property search, paperwork and handover moving in the same direction. His focus is straightforward: a clear next step for the client and a team that follows through.

team.name: Mohd Shahid Khan
team.bio: Ensures smooth day-to-day office operations while managing the company's IT systems and digital infrastructure. Coordinates administrative processes, streamlines workflows, and provides reliable technical support to keep the business running efficiently.

team.name: Issaadi Chahrazed
team.bio: Specializes in Dubai's off-plan properties, helping clients identify high-potential investment opportunities. Provides expert advice on new launches, payment plans, and market trends to help buyers make confident decisions.

team.name: Talha Shabbir
team.bio: Talha Shabbir is the first conversation behind new relationships at SWK. He helps turn a broad property brief into a practical discussion about location, budget and timing, connecting clients with the right consultant and keeping communication clear from the outset.

team.name: Fareed Choudhary
team.bio: Fareed Choudhary helps buyers look beyond a striking photograph. His approach centres on how a home will actually work: the layout, the neighbourhood, the ongoing costs and the questions to settle before making an offer. He supports clients through shortlisting, viewings and the next steps toward purchase.

properties.title: Golf Fields
properties.description: Green living and a connected community by Emaar in Dubai South, wrapped around landscaped golf-course fairways. 1, 2 & 3 bedroom apartments (priced from the 1-bedroom configuration) with resident pool, BBQ deck, and golf-course views. Off-plan with an 80/20 payment plan and handover scheduled for Q3 2030.

properties.title: Raw District 2
properties.description: A bold, urban 1-bedroom apartment by Imtiaz Developments on Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai's most connected corridor. Raw District 2 pairs an industrial-inspired design language with a full suite of lifestyle amenities — from a residents' library and design lab to curated dining and lounge spaces. Off-plan with a 50/50 payment plan and handover scheduled for Q2 2029.

properties.title: River Cove Residences
properties.description: A waterfront residential development by Sobha Realty on Abu Dhabi's coastline, offering 1 & 2 bedroom apartments with private balconies over landscaped pools and direct water views. Off-plan with a flexible 60/40 payment plan and handover scheduled for Q4 2029.
